def: The target industry or field where the manufactured product is used
Specific applications in sectors like aerospace, automotive, or medical
制造产品所应用的具体行业或使用场景
产品在航空航天、汽车、制药或医疗等行业的具体应用范畴
Biological or medical entities related to bio-manufacturing
Biomedical materials or anatomical structures like bones, tendons, or scaffolds
与生物制造或医学工程直接相关的生物学实体
如骨小梁、组织支架、淀粉、肌腱等生物医用材料或解剖结构
Techniques and methods used for measuring or analyzing material properties
Evaluation processes like CT scans or X-ray diffraction
用于测量、分析或表征材料特性的技术和手段
如CT扫描、X射线衍射等材料性能评估和实验检测过程
Theoretical concepts, models, or overarching principles in manufacturing discipline
Abstract engineering theories such as friction models or the concept of Smart Manufacturing
制造学科中的理论模型、科学原理或宏观指导概念
如摩擦磨损理论、智能制造等抽象理念和学术规律
Foundational software or technologies supporting modern manufacturing
Digital concept and systematic enablers like CAD, blockchain, or communication protocols
支持和赋能现代智能制造业的底层软件或信息技术
如计算机辅助设计(CAD)、区块链或通信协议(OPC/UA)等数字化支撑技术
Geometric or structural engineering features of a manufactured part
Physical traits or design characteristics like slots, fillets, or extrusions
制造零件的几何外貌或结构工程特征
产品设计上的物理特征，如切口、挤压特征、槽孔或圆角
Substances or materials used in manufacturing, such as stainless steel or titanium alloy
Raw material components used to produce goods
用于制造物品的物理物质或材料，例如不锈钢或钛合金
生产加工过程中使用的基础原材料
Tools, instruments, or heavy machinery used during production
Mechanical devices and equipment like CNC machines, lathes, or sensors
生产过程中使用的机器设备、工具或测量仪器
如车床、数控机床或传感器等具体的机械生产装置
Methods and processes used to manufacture products, like forming or joining
The specific operational process applied in manufacturing
用于制造产品的工艺和方法，如增材制造、成型或焊接
生产加工过程中使用的具体工艺步骤或制造技术
Established norms, file formats, or standardized classifications in engineering
Industry-recognized specifications like ISO, ASTM, or STL/STEP formats
工程设计和制造中公认的法律规范、文件格式或标准化分类体系
如ISO分类、ASTM标准或STEP、STL等常用的工业规范与通用格式
Quantitative variables and settings governing a manufacturing process
Operating conditions like cutting speed, laser power, or spindle speed
控制机器操作和制造过程的定量变量或运行设置
如切削速度、主轴转速、激光功率或材料去除率等工艺操作参数
Physical or mechanical characteristics of a material, such as hardness or yield strength
Properties describing how a material behaves under load or environment
材料或产品的物理和机械性能指标
描述材料在受力或特定环境下表现出特性的指标，如耐腐蚀性、屈服强度或硬度
